u-vessel.fixture_limitation: The registered recipe is a single U-shaped tank filled uniformly from x112..365 at y202..247. It does not create unequal communicating columns or a hydrostatic head difference, so this H run is a settled-surface stability/quantization test rather than the intended differential-head leveling test.

long-tail-settling.fixture_note: The recipe uses twelve 6x6 droplets with normalized masses 8,12,16,...,52. Under the registered half-up physical quantization, mass3 (max 7) maps 8/12/16 to zero; those first three leftmost droplets therefore do not exist authoritatively. mass5 retains all droplets; mass8 is exact.
long-tail-settling.sequence_limitation: The retained post-reset motion segments are short (A ~109 ticks, B ~128, C ~264). C has a stale pre-reset frame at tick 1315. The formal screenshots are at ticks 99/47/43. This run is strong tiny-quantity/quantization evidence, but not a balanced long-tail settling comparison out to the registered 1800-tick sample.

direction-horizontal.interpretation_boundary: This existing lab recipe is a horizontally extended Water strip plus a same-row fill event at tick 45; it is useful for lateral persistence/leveling feel but is not a controlled injected-velocity oracle.

calm-settling.interpretation: Strong equilibrium/rest evidence. mass8 reaches the most acceptable final state but the observer explicitly wants leveling 2–4x faster. mass5 retains a residual hill; mass3 forms an unacceptable lump.

direction-diagonal.interpretation: Confirms the same slump/terrace family under diagonal initialization. mass8 is visually lively but has flickering hillnipple/terrace boundaries; mass5 calms terraces but edge drips die sooner; mass3 again collapses into poor slump behavior.
direction-diagonal.owner_annotation: Blind C screenshot marks a central 'hillnipple' and multiple 'terrace edges'.

ledge-sheet.interpretation: Positive shallow-flow control, but not defect-free. mass8 has the best flow and interesting front breakup phases; persistent hill/terrace structure and vertical-line phase remain undesirable. mass3 again slumps badly.

owner_annotation.interpretation: The owner likes several breakup/front motifs as possible visual/behavioral ingredients, but explicitly dislikes the vertical-block/vertical-line phase. Preserve useful motifs as references, not as proof the current glitch is correct.

programme_disposition.mass_bits: No production selection. Retain mass8 as numerical/control oracle; retest practical widths after bulk-flow and presentation repairs.
programme_disposition.issue_26: Proceed with automated head/depth response and bounded leveling characterization before semantic candidate integration.
programme_disposition.issue_18: Remain open. Do not close or admit compact directional history until the residual directional-memory deficit is isolated after #26.
programme_disposition.presentation: Required later layer; may hide visual quantization but must not substitute for correct authoritative bulk flow.
programme_disposition.u_vessel_fixture: Do not use the current u-vessel H recipe as evidence for communicating-column/head equalization. Replace/add an automated unequal-head U-tube fixture under #26; retain this run as settled-surface evidence.
programme_disposition.tiny_quantity_precision: Long-tail-settling supplies direct representability evidence: mass3 discards the three smallest registered droplets at initial quantization. Rendering cannot restore authoritative Water that quantized to zero. Treat mass3 as strongly disfavored if these tiny quantities are gameplay-relevant; retain 5/6/8 (and 4 only as an explicit risk arm) for later post-#26 retesting.
programme_disposition.direction_horizontal: Revealed result: mass8 Good/rank1, mass5 Good/rank2, mass3 Reject/rank3. C was perceived to sustain lateral flow longer than B; A retained excessive height differential. This is useful evidence of precision-dependent lateral leveling persistence, but the existing fixture is a same-row strip/fill experiment rather than a clean injected-velocity history oracle, so it does not by itself admit #18 compact motion history.
programme_disposition.calm_settling: Mass8 can reach an acceptable calm final state, but current leveling speed is still perceived 2–4x too slow. This materially strengthens #26's leveling-speed target and suggests measuring time-to-flat, not only final error.
programme_disposition.direction_diagonal: Diagonal initialization reproduces slump, hillnipple and terrace-edge artifacts. Useful as anisotropy/edge-stability evidence; no separate diagonal-only architecture is justified yet.
programme_disposition.ledge_sheet: Shallow-flow positive control confirms useful lively edge/dribble/front behavior exists and must be preserved while #26 accelerates deep-water leveling. Treat serpentine/splashy/front-speckle motifs as references; reject persistent vertical-block artifacts.
